changes: Added Game Tools Hub as the central launcher for Game Launcher Bot and PW Account Hub.
Changed the Windows release into a unified bundle containing all three applications.
Added component-aware update checks to Game Tools Hub.
The first Game Launcher Bot update now installs Game Tools Hub and PW Account Hub automatically.
Preserved Game Launcher Bot settings, accounts and logs together with PW Account Hub browser data during bundle updates.
Kept compatibility with existing Game Launcher Bot installations and the existing update asset name.
